rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a small natural freshwater stream, especially one in the countryside or hills.

example.english: Walking along the creek and listening to the water is really relaxing.
example.traditional: 我哋沿住條溪澗行，聽住啲水聲真係好舒服。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyun4 zyu6 tiu4 kai1 gaan3 haang4 teng1 zyu6 di1 seoi2 seng1 zan1 hai6 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this only when referring to an Australian creek that is large enough to be described as a river in Cantonese.

example.english: That Australian creek only has water in the wet season; it dries up in the dry season.
example.traditional: 澳洲嗰條河喺雨季先至有水，旱季就乾晒。
example.jyutping: ou3 zau1 go2 tiu4 ho4 hai2 jyu5 gwai3 sin1 zi3 jau5 seoi2 hon5 gwai3 zau6 gon1 saai3
